# Giant Wolf Spider (`monsters:giant-wolf-spider`)
*Medium beast, unaligned* | **CR** 1/4 (XP 50; PB +2)
**AC** 13 | **HP** 11 (2d8 + 2) | **Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
**STR** 12 (+1) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 3 (-4) | **WIS** 12 (+1) | **CHA** 4 (-3)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +3, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +7
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Blindsight 10 ft., Passive Perception 13
**Languages:** None

## Traits
- **Spider Climb.** The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

## Actions
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
